important_evidence: AMPlify is an AMP prediction tool with code available at https://github.com/bcgsc/AMPlify.
The tool was used to mine UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot and identified 8008 novel putative AMPs from eukaryotic sequences.
Experimental validation: 38 peptides synthesized, 13 active (34% hit rate).
uncertainties: The paper (PMID 40100125) is a mining study using AMPlify, not necessarily the original AMPlify model publication; the true AMPlify original paper may be different.
No model weights or pre-trained model file is provided in the repository or paper.
Training dataset and exact architecture details are not described in the available evidence.
